name: Easy Mac and Cheese
description: Baked macaroni in a creamy cheddar sauce with a parmesan breadcrumb topping.

instructions.text: Set out a large pasta pot, a saucepan, a sieve, a whisk, and a 2-quart baking dish. Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Peel and quarter 1 onion. Peel and lightly crush 1 garlic clove with the flat side of a knife. Grate 1 1/2 cups cheddar and 1/2 cup Parmesan.

Pour 3 cups milk into the saucepan. Add the onion, garlic, and 1 bay leaf. Heat over medium-low heat for 8–10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until steaming with small bubbles at the edges; do not boil. Turn off the heat and strain into a heatproof bowl or jug. Discard the onion, garlic, and bay leaf.

Bring 3 quarts (12 cups) water to a rolling boil in the pasta pot over high heat. Add 12 ounces dry macaroni, stir, and cook for 2 minutes less than the package time so it finishes in the oven. Stir every 1–2 minutes. Drain carefully through the colander or sieve; do not rinse.

Melt 3 1/2 tablespoons butter in the empty saucepan over medium-low heat. Add 0.4 cup all-purpose flour (6 tablespoons plus 1 teaspoon, approximately) and stir constantly for 1–2 minutes until it forms a smooth pale paste. This paste is called a roux; keep it pale rather than browned.

Whisk in about 1/2 cup warm milk until the paste loosens and becomes smooth. Add the remaining warm milk gradually while whisking. Cook over medium-low heat for 5–8 minutes, stirring and scraping the bottom, until the sauce lightly coats the back of a spoon. Lower the heat if it bubbles vigorously.
Turn off the heat. Stir in the 1 1/2 cups cheddar in 3 additions until melted, then stir in 1 teaspoon prepared mustard. Add the drained macaroni and stir until every piece is coated.
Spoon into the baking dish. Mix 1/2 cup breadcrumbs with the 1/2 cup grated Parmesan and scatter evenly over the top.
Bake on the center rack for 20–25 minutes until bubbling at the edges and lightly golden on top. Remove with oven mitts and rest for 5 minutes before dividing into 4 servings.

source.originalInstructions: Infuse warm milk with onion, garlic, and bay leaf, then strain. Cook the macaroni. Make a butter-and-flour roux, whisk in the milk, melt in cheddar and mustard, combine with the pasta, and bake with parmesan and breadcrumbs.
